acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, or Parker, the main local issue is that framing has to fit the existing home, local site conditions, and the way the addition connects to nearby structures. That matters even more in tighter lots or neighborhoods where access, staging, and inspection timing can affect the job.
